is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.s. (page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotypes for Vgsc L995F, Vgsc L995S, Vgsc N1570Y, and Ace-1 G119S (Table 3, page 11).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 provides allele frequencies (0, 0.5, 0.83, 1.0) for various mutations across different populations (Bungoma, Kisumu, Pimperena).

african_field_population.evidence: The Bungoma population was collected from the field in western Kenya (page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study using RNA-seq and HITSS assays on mosquito populations.

sub_country_location.evidence: The Bungoma population was collected from Bumula sub-county, Bungoma county, western Kenya (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted between March and October 2017 (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new collections and experiments.

supplement.evidence: The required genotype data is provided in Table 3 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study investigated the molecular mechanisms of reduced behavioral sensitivity to transfluthrin in Anopheles gambiae s.s. using HITSS assays and RNA-seq. It identified overexpression of detoxification genes (e.g., CYP12F12) and analyzed target-site mutations (kdr L995F/S, N1570Y, Ace-1 G119S) in field-collected (Bungoma) and laboratory (Kisumu, Pimperena) populations.
